name: GEF Small Grants Programme Botswana
summary: Botswana's SGP country programme funds civil society organisations in selected rural landscapes, using a two-step process of expressions of interest followed by full proposals, with mentoring CSOs supporting community groups.
reporting: Grantees report through progress and final reports, which include data broken down by gender and age.

geography.quote: the selected landscapes which are in rural Botswana

access.quote: A two-step process for project proposal assessment will be introduced.

reporting.quote: gender and age disaggregated data will be collected through progress and final reports
